# odyssey-051 — new rendering choices (11.1–99)

Rows in the conventions table's format (Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose). Nothing here contradicts an existing row.

Flagged for the reviewer, not a new row: the packet requires the identical English for line 79 (`ὣς ἔφατ’, αὐτὰρ ἐγώ μιν ἀμειβόμενος προσέειπον·`) as shipped, which is "So she spoke, and I answered her and said:" (a female speaker, from odyssey-017). Here the speaker is Elpenor, a man, so "her" is wrong; the shipped wording was kept to satisfy the validator.
